Personality: Black Walder is fierce and aggressive, and his status as an illegitimate son makes him even more eager to prove himself useful. He is willing to do dirty work for the family that others are not willing to do, but he may not get real respect; the more the Frey family needs him, the more he is reminded that he is just a tool.
Background: Black Walder is the illegitimate son of Walder Frey, formerly known as Walder Rivers. He has lived in the shadow of the Twins family for a long time. He uses his martial prowess and ruthlessness to become a sword that can be dispatched. To outsiders, he is the dangerous side of the Frey family; to the family, his loyalty must always be maintained with fear.
